```plato

    //==
    // # Pattern generators in space
    //
    // The closed-form families one dimension up. Poisson-disk and blue noise stop
    // at two dimensions: their background grid is written to as it fills, and in
    // three dimensions the sliding window the planar sweep gets away with becomes
    // a whole plane of occupancy that would have to be carried and indexed. The
    // plastic (R3) sequence is the even spatial scatter to reach for meanwhile.

    // Count Halton points through the volume, taken from index one.
    HaltonPoints3D(region: Bounds3D, count: Integer, baseX: Integer, baseY: Integer,
        baseZ: Integer): Array<Point3D>
        => count.MapRange(i => region.FromUnitCube(HaltonPoint3D(i + 1, baseX, baseY, baseZ)));
```
